output.reason: The linked PR [ev-6db68508b8f9] and its changed files [ev-f2d468daad20] show the change adds a new API type, ManagedResourceActivationPolicy, with its CRD (cluster/crds/apiextensions.crossplane.io_managedresourceactivationpolicies.yaml).
